card.name: Partway through long medical terms
card.fires_on: Fires on a piece of a longer word or title in medical text, where the next piece is easy to predict. Examples are BOXED WARN(INGS), Patient Counseling (Information), stromal and wheal.

modes.label: Label section titles
modes.description: Marks the middle of fixed label headings such as BOXED WARNINGS or Patient Counseling Information.

modes.label: Split medical words
modes.description: Marks a word piece inside a longer clinical term that is still unfinished.
